verdicts.reason: A: a sensible banner split with a balanced headline break ('Box fresh, / half price'), but the 48H ONLY badge text is unreadably tiny, the box is crammed toward the bottom-left, and the CTA sits tight to the right edge. B: same left-panel problems (tiny illegible badge, box nearly touching the bottom edge), plus an orphaned 'price' on the second headline line and a CTA almost flush against the right canvas edge, which makes it feel cramped and unfinished.
